Advance in search for gene polymorphisms on pharmacokinetics of atorvastatin
HAO Fang-fang, DU Yi-min, LAI Yong(Department of Pharmacology, College of Pharmacy and Chemistry, Dali University, Dali YUNNAN 671000, China)[KEY WORDS] atorvastatin; pharmacokinetics; hydroxymethylglutaryl-CoA reductase inhibitors; polymorphism, single nucleotide[ABSTRACT] Atorvastatin is the most commonly used blood lipid medication, which can significantly reduce the plasma low-density lipoprotein cholesterol levels and prevent cardiovascular diseases. But for different individuals, the efficacies of atorvastatin are very different. The studies had shown that gene polymorphisms were the important factors led to diversity of pharmacokinetics in different individuals. The pharmacokinetic characteristics of atorvastatin and its gene polymorphisms were reviewed in this paper to supply some advices for the individual use of atorvastatin in clinic.[作者简介] 郝芳芳（1988—），女，白族，云南鹤庆人，硕士研究生，主要从事临床药理研究，Phn：86-872-2257，ext 412，E-mail：dalihff@yahoo.com.cn；赖泳（1973—），女，云南耿马人，硕士，副教授，硕士生导师，主要从事临床药理研究，Phn：86-872-2257，ext 412，E-mail：laiyong8879@yahoo.com.cn[责任作者] 赖泳
